raw: {"analysis":"Response BBM provides a more operationally rigorous plan that addresses the critical repository facts more thoroughly. BBM explicitly requires a pre-ingestion cluster snapshot (directly addressing the irreversibility constraint), specifies the shadow hierarchy to prevent accidental live writes, and handles the Friday flaky check with a concrete triage path via `flake_ledger` rather than just excluding it. Response GWS is solid but less precise on the irreversibility mitigation and the flaky check handling is somewhat hand-wavy. BBM also better addresses the zero-downtime requirement with the feature flag approach and per-customer enablement.","verdict":"BBM"}
